summary: Frontend-only GPTour acceptance verification run: targeted/full unit tests, TypeScript, and targeted lint all passed. Browser isolated fixture flow reached login and GPTour but failed before pool build due fixture/interception contract mismatches (strict orphan config/rpc path + JWT/auth side-calls), so end-to-end acceptance button assertions could not be completed.

integration_issues.issue: Fixture session logged in, but additional runtime calls produced 401/JWT errors and GPTour pool load halted with 'Configurazione orfani non verificata. Nessuna regola CRM è stata sostituita.'
Blocked: unable to reach stable loaded GPTour pool in browser fixture, therefore could not execute/validate full accept button chain in runtime UI.

action_items: Provide/standardize a complete browser-fixture interception map for all auth/profile/dashboard/GPTour dependencies before opening GPTour (including strict orphan config + orphan RPC contract in single-object/single-row shapes).
Ensure synthetic auth token/session fixture is accepted by all intercepted consumers to prevent fallback 401/JWT cryptographic errors during dashboard/GPTour bootstrap.

Re-run mandatory browser acceptance chain after fixture completeness: initial orphan-only result -> accept proposal -> 2 stops retained -> rebuild retained -> save RPC payload includes exact acceptedFillKeys and unchanged requested/allowed intent arrays.
critical_code_review_comments: Receipt trust hardening appears correct in source: acceptedFillKeys read only from local gptourContext and intent patch sanitizer does not ingest acceptance metadata from AI payloads.
Per-key acceptance logic is explicit/exact (acceptDisplayedFillKeys + acceptedCandidateProblems) and does not mutate requestedEntityTypes/allowedExpansionTypes.
Draft isolation guard exists (loadedDraftKey gate) to avoid persisting stale draft data during actor/agent switch windows.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not claim SQL/runtime inspection resolved: previous exec_sql 403 remains unchanged and was not re-validated. This run kept testing isolated and did not perform DB migration/publication/git operations.
